portraits.descricao: A fully animated detective magnifying glass character named Lupa, for a Brazilian 5th-grade educational comic book. Her body is a round glass lens (circular, transparent with a subtle golden shine), attached to a golden metal handle (#F59E0B) that bends and transforms into her arms and legs (thin golden limbs, small three-fingered hands). Large expressive cartoon eyes are drawn inside the lens glass itself, with a small stitched-style smile. She wears a small detective deerstalker cap in dark brown (#78350F) on top of her lens-head. The glass lens glows bright golden-yellow with small sparkle effects. Full-body illustration, standing pose, one arm raised in a confident happy gesture, big smile, cap slightly tilted. Vibrant Brazilian children's educational comic book style, bold outlines, clean cel-shading, bright saturated colors, exaggerated cartoonish proportions. Warm amber/gold palette: primary #B45309, light accent #F59E0B, dark shadow #78350F. Plain solid background, no scenery, no text, no speech bubbles, no other characters.

An animated ball of yarn / weaving thread character named Fio, for a Brazilian 5th-grade educational comic book. Body shaped like a rounded, plump yarn spool/skein made of soft looping thread coils. Main color: warm amber/golden yellow (#F59E0B) for the bulk of the yarn body, with darker brown thread details (#B45309) wrapped in decorative spiral patterns around the body. A single loose thread end extends from the top of Fio's body and moves expressively like a small arm, curling upward in a friendly wave gesture. Two large round expressive cartoon eyes are embroidered/stitched directly onto the yarn body (simple stitched-cross pupils), with a small stitched smiling mouth below them. No visible legs, Fio hovers with a gentle bounce, small motion lines beneath the body. Full-body illustration, cheerful greeting pose. Vibrant Brazilian children's educational comic book style, bold outlines, clean cel-shading, bright saturated colors, exaggerated cartoonish proportions. Warm amber/brown palette: primary #B45309, light accent #F59E0B, dark shadow #78350F. Plain solid background, no scenery, no text, no speech bubbles, no other characters.
